context:
Goal: a builder cannot weaken the mutation tests that prove a guard works.
Problem (rule): main lets builders edit hooks/mutate_guard.py (pinned by hooks/test_guard.py line 13028; hooks/agent_brief.py line 30 tells builders to add mutants). Decision builders-cannot-edit-tests refuses their edits to other test files.
Based on (read): a probe on main 174b005c1. A builder's Edit, Write and sed -i on mutate_guard.py are all allowed.
Based on (ruling): builders-cannot-edit-tests. Asked because it does not say whether a mutant file counts as a test file, and the builder brief tells builders to add mutants.
Departs from: main, where a builder may edit any mutant — c refuses a builder diff that removes or changes an existing mutant line.

options.gain: Keeps the brief's add step, and stops a builder weakening a mutant.
options.label: Builders may add mutants only (recommended)
options.lose: A builder whose fix moves a mutant's anchor needs a test-author pass.

options.gain: One rule for all test files.
options.label: Only test authors may change mutants
options.lose: Every new mutant needs a test-author pass.

options.label: Keep as is, and record it
options.lose: A builder can weaken a mutant to get a green run.

ref: decision builders-cannot-edit-tests; step notes-fix-builder-mutants; notes row mutate-guard-owner-unclear
reply: Withdrawn 17:58 CST. The coordinator took c at 17:55 CST: builders may add mutants, and a builder diff that removes or changes a mutant line is refused. It tightens main and can be undone, so it needs no owner word. Home: decision builders-cannot-edit-tests, in lane notes-fix-merge-ci's PR.
short: Who may change a guard's mutation tests
title: May a builder change the mutation tests that prove a guard works?
why: Main lets builders edit hooks/mutate_guard.py, but refuses their edits to other test files. The lane parks this step until you pick.
